views.name: player_career_spans
views.body_sql: SELECT player_id, debut AS debut_date, final_game AS final_date, CAST(ABS(julianday(final_game) - julianday(debut)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS career_span_years FROM player
views.description: one row per baseball player containing debut date, final game date, and the computed career span in years derived from the absolute difference in years, months, and days

views.name: average_career_span
views.body_sql: SELECT AVG(career_span_years) AS average_career_span_years FROM player_career_spans
views.description: single-row aggregate computing the mean of the career span values across all players
